lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: You humiliated me in front of half the school, Potter. That mistaken identity bit was cruel and calculated.
lines.expression: hands fisting the oversized lapels, chin thrust upward

lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: Filch is wheezing toward us through the archway right now. We argue later if we still can.
lines.expression: eyes fixed on the archway, hand drifting to wand pocket

lines.speaker: Argus Filch
lines.text: Somebody is out of bed again tonight, and I will find every last one of you before the professors do.
lines.expression: lantern raised in the archway, breath rasping
